classes.name: ActActor

notes: Relationships: ActActor holds ActCharacter* (+0), ActPoser* (+4), ActAnimGroup* (+8), WWorldPos* (+0xc), all created in its ctor; none of ActActor/ActPoser/ActCharacter/ActSkeleton inherit from each other or have a vptr.

The packet's 'ActPoser 220' allocation is ActCharacterInfo: ActCharacter::ChangeCharacter 14a50 does FastAlloc(0xdc, tag 0x189ddc)->15260 and frees with size 0xdc; ActActor's ActPoser alloc uses the same tag 0x189ddc with size 0x70. ActPoser is 0x70 only.

ActWeapon's base is RAutonomousObj (0x80), not RSceneObj directly: Xbox ctor 1abd0 copies the identity matrix at *(0x1c4654) to this+0x40 and passes &this+0x40 to RSceneObj::RSceneObj 8eec0, the RAutonomousObj allocation-site pattern; PS2 1162a8 does the equivalent (instance at PS2 +0, RSceneObj part at +0x40, vptr at +0x7c). If RAutonomousObj should stay a leaf, use base RSceneObj plus a CARP::Instance at +0x40.

ActActor ctor (both builds, 7 args, RET 0x1c): (int id, char *character, char *weapon1, char *weapon2, callback, MATRIX4 &initial, bool). The current Ghidra Xbox prototype ('ulong ActActor(ActActor*, ActActor*, int, ulong, char*...') is wrong.
ActCharacter::GetShadowTriangle 14870 is ~0x1e0 bytes, not an accessor of +0x68 despite the short-method hint; return type not set.
PS2 sizes: ActActor 0x64 (fields to +0x60), ActPoser 0x74 (PS2 ActActor new(0x74)), ActCharacter 0x84 (same as Xbox).
ActShellCasing (0x14, name invented): COORD3 pos +0, int expireFrame +0xc, float +0x10 (random scale), from StartMuzzleFlash 1b270.
